annotation.title_clean: In-service safety for automated vehicles – COAG Consultation Regulation Impact Statement
annotation.title_en: In-service safety for automated vehicles – COAG Consultation Regulation Impact Statement
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Transport Commission (NTC) / COAG Transport and Infrastructure Council
annotation.venue: Impact Analysis Database (Australian Government Office of Impact Analysis)
annotation.summary_en: Web page for the NTC's Consultation Regulation Impact Statement to COAG on in-service safety of automated vehicles in Australia. It considers national regulatory options and the roles of manufacturers, repairers and owners, since new in-service safety risks are not mitigated by the market or current regulations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Automated vehicles may bring new in-service safety risks not addressed by current regulation or the market
Consultation RIS examines roles of manufacturers, repairers, registered owners and others
Considers legal arrangements needed to support safe operation of automated vehicles
Informs a COAG Transport and Infrastructure Council decision on national regulatory arrangements
Approved by the Office of Best Practice Regulation
